# Single-cell analysis - Pipeline 1 - Distinguish tumor and immune cells

Here, we will perform the first single cell analysis steps, including distinguishing immune and non-immune cells.

## Read in data and filter
First, we will read in the `SingleCellExperiment` object containing the cleaned, single-cell data. 
**Important:** For now, We will filter the object for tumor and ccRCC samples only. 

```{r read-data-batch-correction, message=FALSE}
sce <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_02.rds")

#Filter sce for tumor cells (subtype information should be provided)
sce <- sce[,!is.na(sce$subtype)]

#Filter sce for ccRCC samples (n=590708)
summary(str_detect(colData(sce)$subtype,"clear_cell_RCC"))

sce <- sce[,str_detect(colData(sce)$subtype,"clear_cell_RCC")]
```

## Perform "overclustering"

Next, we will run a granular graph-based clustering (Jaccard-based weights, Louvain clustering as community detection algorithm). 

```{r overcluster, message=FALSE}
set.seed(22)
snn.sce <- buildSNNGraph(sce[rowData(sce)$use_channel==TRUE,], k=30, 
                         d = NA, 
                         type = "jaccard",
                         assay.type = "exprs",
                         BNPARAM=AnnoyParam(),
                         BPPARAM = MulticoreParam(workers = (detectCores()-2), progressbar = TRUE)
                         )

clusters <- igraph::cluster_louvain(snn.sce)
sce$cluster <- as.factor(clusters$membership)
unique(sce$cluster)
saveRDS(sce, "/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_03.rds")
```

## Use GMM for CD45

We will use a two component gaussian mixture model to distinguish between immune and non_immune cells

```{r GMM_CK, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
#rename CD45RA to CD45 (mix of RA and RO)
rownames(sce) <- str_replace(rownames(sce),"CD45RA","CD45")

## Gaussian mixture model to distinguish tumor/stroma based on CD45 expression
set.seed(22)
GMM_CD45 <- Mclust(assay(sce, "exprs")["CD45",], G = 2)

GMM_df <- data.frame(class_CD45 = ifelse(GMM_CD45$classification == 2, "CD45+", "CD45-"), 
                     CD45_exprs = assay(sce, "exprs")["CD45",],
                     uncertainty = GMM_CD45$uncertainty)

#Visualize GMM
GMM_plot_exp <- ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = CD45_exprs, fill = class_CD45))+
  geom_density()+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1")
  
GMM_plot_unc <- ggplot(GMM_df, aes(x = CD45_exprs, y = uncertainty, color = class_CD45))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic(base_size = 15)+
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())+
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1")

GMM_plot_exp/GMM_plot_unc

#Add GMM CD45 class to SCE
sce$GMM_CD45 <- GMM_df$class_CD45

#Save sce after GMM
saveRDS(sce,"/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_03.rds")
```

## Heatmap 

Heatmap of clusters with GMM information 

```{r heatmap, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#Read sce after clustering and GMM
#sce <- readRDS("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_03.rds")

### 1. Marker Heatmap 

#Min-Max [0,1] normalization of arcsinh-transformed counts
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "exprs") - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs"))
assay(sce, "min_max") <- assay(sce, "min_max") / (rowMaxs(assay(sce, "exprs")) - rowMins(assay(sce, "exprs")))

#Aggregrate across cells with the mean (median is also possible)
mean_sce <- aggregateAcrossCells(sce, ids = sce$cluster,
                                 statistics = "mean",
                                 use.assay.type = "min_max",
                                 subset.row = rowData(sce)$use_channel)

### 2. Spatial Heatmap
#Add number of neighbors to sce object (saved in ColPair)
n_neighbors <- colPair(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by(from) %>% count() %>% arrange(desc(n))

sce$n_neighbors <- n_neighbors$n[match(seq_along(colnames(sce)),n_neighbors$from)]
sce$n_neighbors <- sce$n_neighbors %>% replace_na(0)

#Select spatial features and average over clusters 
spatial <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(area,eccentricity,cluster,n_neighbors)
spatial <- spatial %>% select(-cluster) %>% aggregate(by = list(cluster = spatial$cluster), FUN = mean) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")

#Create Spatial Heatmap Annotation
ha_spatial = HeatmapAnnotation(
    area = spatial$area,
    eccentricity = spatial$eccentricity,
    n_neighbors = spatial$n_neighbors, 
    col = list(area = colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$area),median(spatial$area),max(spatial$area)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Blues")[3])),
               eccentricity = colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$eccentricity ),median(spatial$eccentricity ),max(spatial$eccentricity)), c(brewer.pal(3,"Greens")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Greens")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Greens")[3])),
               n_neighbors = colorRamp2(c(min(spatial$n_neighbors ),median(spatial$n_neighbors ),max(spatial$n_neighbors)),c(brewer.pal(3,"Oranges")[1],brewer.pal(3,"Oranges")[2],brewer.pal(3,"Oranges")[3]))
    ),
    border = TRUE,
    which = "row")

### 3. Row annotation plots with number and fraction of tumor cells
#GMM - CD45
nr_immune <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame %>% select(cluster, GMM_CD45) %>% table()
fr_immune <- as.data.frame(nr_immune) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = GMM_CD45, values_from = Freq) %>% column_to_rownames("cluster")
fr_immune <- fr_immune %>% transmute(fr_immune = `CD45+`/rowSums(fr_immune)) %>% as.data.frame()

ggplot(fr_immune, aes(fr_immune))+
  geom_density()

### 4. Define immuneor and stroma cluster (Fraction of immuneor cells according to GMM >80%)
anno_immune <- fr_immune %>% rownames_to_column(var = "cluster") %>% mutate(cluster_category = ifelse(fr_immune >= 0.5,"Immune","Non-Immune"))

col <- list(cluster = colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Paired"))(length(unique(anno_immune$cluster))),
           cluster_category = c("#1F78B4","#B2DF8A"))

col_list_1 <- foreach(i=1:2) %do% {
  color= col[[i]]
  names(color)= sort(unique(anno_immune[,names(col)[i]]))
  color
}
names(col_list_1) <- c(names(col))

#heatmap body color 
col_main = viridis(100)


### Plot combined Heatmap
h <- Heatmap(t(assay(mean_sce, "min_max")),
        col = col_main,
        name= "min-max",
        km = 1,
        show_row_names = T, 
        show_column_names =  T, 
        clustering_method_rows = "ward.D2",
        clustering_method_columns = "ward.D2")+
  ha_spatial+
  rowAnnotation(panCK_CD45 = anno_barplot(fr_immune, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = "#377EB8", col = 1)),annotation_name_rot = 90)+
  rowAnnotation(Number_Cells = anno_barplot(nr_immune, width = unit(10, "mm"),gp = gpar(fill = c("#E41A1C","#377EB8"), col = 1)),annotation_name_rot = 90)+
  rowAnnotation(cluster = anno_immune$cluster,
                cluster_category = anno_immune$cluster_category,
                col = col_list_1, 
                border = TRUE)

draw(h)

### Add cluster_categories to sce
sce$cluster_category <- anno_immune$cluster_category[match(sce$cluster,anno_immune$cluster)]

#These categories will be used for downstream analysis

#Save sce
saveRDS(sce,"/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/pan_immune/data_analysis/sce_panimmune_RCC_03.rds")
```

## Visualization of results on UMAP/TSNE

```{r viz_sub, message = FALSE, warning=FALSE}
## Subsample 10% of cells from each core 
#to save time and not get super crowded dimensionality reduction plots
set.seed(22011995)
sub <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% group_by("sample_id") %>% slice_sample(prop = 0.1) %>% arrange("sample_id") %>% mutate(sub_id = paste(sample_id,ObjectNumber,sep="_")) %>% pull(sub_id)
sce_sub = sce[,sub]
sce_sub$cluster = as.factor(sce_sub$cluster)  

#Run UMAP/TSNE
sce_sub = runUMAP(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], n_neighbors = 30, pca = 50,exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam((detectCores()-2)))
sce_sub = runTSNE(sce_sub[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel,], exprs_values = "exprs", external_neighbors=TRUE, BPPARAM = MulticoreParam((detectCores()-2)))

## 1. Visualize UMAP
#panCK and GMM_CK
p1 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "panCK")

p2 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "GMM_CK")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1")

#p3 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "astir_type")+
#  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1")

p4 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "cluster_category")+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_list_1[[2]])

p5 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "analysis_cat")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1")

(p1+p2)/(p4+p5)

#Visualize all marker expression
all_plots_UMAP <- lapply(c(rownames(sce_sub)[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "UMAP", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)
                      return(p)                    
                    })

library(cowplot)
plots_UMAP_exp <- plot_grid(plotlist = all_plots_UMAP)


## 2. Visualize TSNE
#panCK and GMM_CK
p6 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs",colour_by = "panCK")

p7 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", by_exprs_values = "exprs", colour_by = "Ecad")

p8 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "cluster_category")+
  scale_color_manual(values = col_list_1[[2]])

p9 <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", colour_by = "analysis_cat")+
  scale_color_brewer(palette="Set1")

(p6+p7)/(p8+p9)

#Visualize all marker expression
all_plots_TSNE <- lapply(c(rownames(sce_sub)[rowData(sce_sub)$use_channel]),
                    function(x){
                      p <- plotReducedDim(sce_sub, dimred = "TSNE", 
                                          colour_by = x, 
                                          by_exprs_values = "exprs",
                                          point_size = 0.5)
                      return(p)                    
                    })

library(cowplot)
plots_TSNE_exp <- plot_grid(plotlist = all_plots_TSNE)

#Save sce_sub
#saveRDS(sce_sub, "/Volumes/rcc_volume/TNBC/data_analysis/sce_TNBC_Clus_249_sub.rds")
```

## Estimate fraction of immune cells for each sample/image

```{r tumor cell fraction}
#Per sampleID
tumor_cell_SID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(sample_id,analysis_cat) %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
tumor_cell_SID <- tumor_cell_SID %>% group_by(sample_id) %>% mutate(fra = ((Freq/sum(Freq))*100)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor")

ggplot(tumor_cell_SID, aes(x = analysis_cat,y = fra))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = sample_id), size = 3, position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color=FALSE)

tumor_cell_SID_cut_off <- foreach(i = 0:100, .combine = rbind) %do%{
data.frame(cut_off = i, n_PID = tumor_cell_SID %>% filter(fra > i) %>% ungroup %>% count())
}

ggplot(tumor_cell_SID_cut_off, aes(x=cut_off,y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",color = "black")+
  theme_classic()


#By patient
tumor_cell_PID <- colData(sce) %>% as.data.frame() %>% select(PID,analysis_cat) %>% group_by(PID) %>% table() %>% as.data.frame
tumor_cell_PID <- tumor_cell_PID %>% group_by(PID) %>% mutate(fra = ((Freq/sum(Freq))*100)) %>% filter(analysis_cat == "tumor")

ggplot(tumor_cell_PID, aes(x=analysis_cat,y = fra))+
  geom_boxplot()+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = Freq), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color=FALSE)+
  theme_classic()

ggplot(tumor_cell_PID, aes(x=analysis_cat,y = Freq))+
  geom_boxplot(outlier.color = NA)+
  geom_jitter(aes(color = PID, size = fra), position=position_jitter(w=0.1,h=0.1))+
  guides(color=FALSE)+
  theme_classic()

tumor_cell_PID_cut_off <- foreach(i = 0:100, .combine = rbind) %do%{
data.frame(cut_off = i, n_PID = tumor_cell_PID %>% filter(fra > i) %>% ungroup %>% count())
}

ggplot(tumor_cell_PID_cut_off, aes(x=cut_off,y = n))+
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black")+
  theme_classic()


#Choose filter criteria
#here total frequency of tumor cells per PID (two samples) > 30 (100?)
PID_select_tumor_content <- tumor_cell_PID %>% filter(Freq > 30) %>% pull(PID) %>% unfactor 

sce$PID_tumor_content <- sce$PID %in% PID_select_tumor_content

```
